## Response rates by treatment

Response rates for each treatment group with all cohorts combined. 

```{r}
get_response_counts_df <- function(clin_metadata) {
  response_counts_df <- clin_metadata %>%
    drop_na(response_splitSD) %>%
    calculate_proportion(treatment, response_splitSD) %>%
    mutate(treatment = str_wrap(paste0(treatment, "\n(n=", total, ")"), width = 8)) %>%
    mutate(response_splitSD = factor(response_splitSD, levels = c("R", "NR")))
  return(response_counts_df)
  
}


get_response_counts_df_by_var <- function(clin_metadata, var) {
  var <- enquo(var)
  response_counts_df <- clin_metadata %>%  
    drop_na(response_splitSD) %>%
    named_group_split(!!var) %>%
    map_dfr( ~ calculate_proportion(..1, treatment, response_splitSD) , .id = rlang::as_name(var)) %>%
    mutate(treatment = str_wrap(paste0(treatment, "\nn=", total), width = 8)) %>%
    mutate(response_splitSD = factor(response_splitSD, levels = c("R", "NR"))) 
  return(response_counts_df)
  
}

plot_response_counts <- function(response_counts_df) {
  response_counts_df %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(treatment, prop, fill = response_splitSD) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_response) +
    theme(
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_blank(),
      legend.direction = "vertical", 
      legend.position = c(1.2, 1),
      plot.margin = margin(r = 35, t = 7)
    ) +
    labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Proportion", fill = "Response")
}
```

```{r, fig.width = 1.75, fig.height = 1.25}
bulk_clin_metadata %>% 
  get_response_counts_df() %>% 
  plot_response_counts()
```

## Progression free survival by treatment

Survival rates for each treatment group with all cohorts combined. 

```{r}
surv_clin_metadata <- bulk_clin_metadata %>%
  filter(cohort != "2016 Weber") %>%
  filter(cohort != "2022 Freeman") %>%
  filter(cohort != "2023 Campbell (067)") %>%
  drop_na(censor_pfs_event_1_progressed_0) %>%
  mutate(censor_pfs = abs(censor_pfs_event_1_progressed_0 - 1)) %>%
  mutate(pfs_months = pfs_days / 30.4375) %>%
  mutate(
    pfs_months = ifelse(pfs_months > 60, 60, pfs_months),
    censor_pfs = ifelse(pfs_months > 60,  0, censor_pfs)
  )
```

```{r}
nrow(bulk_clin_metadata) - nrow(surv_clin_metadata)
```

```{r, fig.width = 4, fig.height = 3}
pfs_fit <- survfit(
  Surv(pfs_months, censor_pfs) ~ treatment,
  data = surv_clin_metadata
)
plot_surv_fit(
  pfs_fit,
  title_str = "Progression Free Survival",
  legend.labs = names(palette_treatment),
  palette = unname(palette_treatment)
)

```

Pairwise p-values: 

```{r}
for (treatment_str in unique(surv_clin_metadata$treatment)) {
  if (treatment_str != "aPD1") {
    out <- survdiff(
      Surv(pfs_months, censor_pfs) ~ treatment,
      data = surv_clin_metadata %>% 
        filter(treatment %in% c("aPD1", treatment_str))
    )
    print(paste0("aPD1 vs ", treatment_str))
    print(out$pvalue)
  }
}

for (treatment_str in unique(surv_clin_metadata$treatment)) {
  if (treatment_str != "combo") {
    out <- survdiff(
      Surv(pfs_months, censor_pfs) ~ treatment,
      data = surv_clin_metadata %>% 
        filter(treatment %in% c("combo", treatment_str))
    )
    print(paste0("combo vs ", treatment_str))
    print(out$pvalue)
  }
}

out <- survdiff(
  Surv(pfs_months, censor_pfs) ~ treatment,
  data = surv_clin_metadata %>% 
    filter(treatment %in% c("aCTLA4", "aPD1 (prior aCTLA4)"))
)
print("aCTLA4 vs aPD1 with prior")
print(out$pvalue)
```

# Immune signature stratification of the bulk cohorts

```{r}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))
```


## Set up

```{r}
immune_hi.v.lo_df <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "immune_hi.v.lo.rds"))
bulk_clin_metadata <- read_tsv(file.path(data_dir, "bulk", "bulk-clin-metadata.tsv")) %>% 
  filter(is.na(excluded_clin) & is.na(excluded_rna)) %>% 
  drop_na(sample_RNA) %>% 
  select(-immune_hi.v.lo, -immune_zscore, -immune_hi.v.lo_zscore) %>% 
  left_join(immune_hi.v.lo_df, by = "sample_RNA") 
immune_signatures <- read_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "immune_signatures.tsv"))$signatures

wes_census_df <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "bulk", "wes_census_discov.csv"))
purity_df <- wes_census_df %>% 
  filter(treatment_context %>% str_detect("pre")) %>% 
  select(participant, facets_purity) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(patient = participant)

tpm_df <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "tpm_df_combatseq.rds"))
tpm_tidy <- tpm_df %>% 
  filter(sample_RNA %in% bulk_clin_metadata$sample_RNA) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = 2:ncol(.), 
               names_to = "gene", 
               values_to = "value")
tpm_matrix <- tpm_df %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sample_RNA") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  t()
signature_df <- read_excel(
  file.path(data_dir, "signatures", "1-s2.0-S1535610821002221-mmc2.xlsx"), 
  sheet = "Gene Description", 
  skip = 1
) %>% mutate(Gene = str_replace(Gene, "-", "."))

signature_list <- signature_df %>% 
  named_group_split(`Gene signature`) %>% 
  map(~.$Gene) 
bagaev_ssgsea_df <- read_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "bagaev_ssgsea_df.tsv"))
bagaev_ssgsea_tidy <- bagaev_ssgsea_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = 2:ncol(.), names_to = "sample_RNA", values_to = "score") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(NAME = gs_name) %>% 
  group_by(NAME) %>% 
  mutate(zscore = as.vector(scale(score))) %>% 
  ungroup()

immune_sig_df <- read_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "external_immune_signatures.txt"))
```

## Immune cell signature clustering

```{r}
h_mtx <- bagaev_ssgsea_tidy %>% 
  filter(NAME %in% immune_signatures) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = NAME, 
              names_from = sample_RNA, 
              values_from = zscore) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("NAME") %>% 
  as.matrix()
```

```{r}
col_ann_df <- bulk_clin_metadata %>% 
  select(sample_RNA, immune_zscore, treatment) %>% 
  arrange(sample_RNA, treatment) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sample_RNA")
col_ann <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = col_ann_df, 
  col = list(
    # immune_hi.v.lo = palette_immune_state, 
    immune_zscore = colorRamp2(breaks = c(-4, 0, 4), c("blue", "white", "red")), 
    treatment = palette_treatment 
    # response_splitSD = palette_response
  )
)
sample_split <- bulk_clin_metadata %>% 
  arrange(sample_RNA, immune_hi.v.lo, treatment, response_splitSD) %>% 
  unite(col_split, immune_hi.v.lo, treatment, response_splitSD) %>% 
  .$col_split
```

The immune high and immune low states are determined through hierarhical clustering. 

```{r, fig.asp = 0.4, fig.width = 12}
Heatmap(
  h_mtx[, rownames(col_ann_df)], 
  name = "scaled score", 
  show_column_names = FALSE, 
  top_annotation = col_ann, 
  column_dend_reorder = TRUE, 
  column_split = 2
)
```

## Proportion responders

```{r}
plot_prop_responders <- function(clin_metadata) {
  prop_df <- clin_metadata %>%
    drop_na(response_splitSD) %>%
    group_by(immune_hi.v.lo, treatment, response_splitSD) %>%
    count() %>%
    group_by(immune_hi.v.lo, treatment) %>%
    mutate(total = sum(n), prop = n / total) %>%
    # add_factors() %>% 
    mutate(treatment = factor(
      treatment %>% 
             paste0("\n(n=", total, ")") %>% 
             str_wrap(width = 8), 
      levels = names(palette_treatment) %>% 
             paste0("\n(n=", total, ")") %>% 
             str_wrap(width = 8)
    ))
  prop_df %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(treatment, prop) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = response_splitSD), width = 0.6) +
    facet_grid(~ immune_hi.v.lo, scale = "free_x") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_response) +
    labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Frequency") +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme(
      axis.line.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      strip.background = element_blank()
    )
}
```

## OR Imm State

```{r}
fisher_out <- bulk_clin_metadata %>%
  drop_na(response_splitSD) %>%
  group_by(treatment, response_splitSD, immune_hi.v.lo) %>%
  count() %>%
  drop_na(response_splitSD) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("treatment", "immune_hi.v.lo"),
    names_from = response_splitSD,
    values_from = n
  ) %>%
  named_group_split(treatment) %>%
  map_dfr(
    ~ ..1 %>%
      dplyr::select(-treatment) %>%
      column_to_rownames("immune_hi.v.lo") %>%
      .[c("immune high", "immune low"), c("R", "NR")] %>%
      fisher.test() %>%
      broom::tidy(),
    .id = "treatment"
  ) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))
```

```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.asp = 1/2}
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 2

fisher_out %>% 
  mutate(treatment = str_wrap(treatment, width = 12)) %>% 
  mutate(p.value.symbol = case_when(
    p.value < 0.001 ~ "***", 
    p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",  
    p.value < 0.05 ~ "*", 
    TRUE ~ "n.s."
  )) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(treatment, estimate) + 
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 18) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1,
             color = "grey",
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = treatment, y = conf.low, yend = conf.high)) + 
  # geom_col(width = 0.5, size = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(estimate, digits = 3), y = 100)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", p.value), y = 400)) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Odds Ratio (Immune high / immune low)") +
  scale_y_log10(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0.1, 900)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.05, 1)) + 
  annotate("text", x = 4.75, y = c(100, 400), label = c("HR", "p-value")) + 
  coord_flip() +
  theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank())
```

## Response by immune score per treatment

The immune score is significantly different between responders and non-responders only in patients treated with combination blockade. 

```{r}
plot_response_by_immune_score_per_treatment <- function(clin_metadata) {
  
  plot_df <- clin_metadata %>%
    mutate(treatment = str_wrap(treatment, width = 15)) %>% 
    drop_na(response_splitSD)
  y_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(treatment) %>%
    summarise(y = max(immune_zscore) + 0.5)
  w_out <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(is_R = case_when(
      response_splitSD == "R" ~ 1, 
      response_splitSD == "NR" ~ 0
    )) %>% 
    group_by(treatment) %>%
    summarise(w = broom::tidy(wilcox.test(immune_zscore ~ is_R))) %>% 
    unnest(w) %>% 
    mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    left_join(y_df)
  plot_df %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(response_splitSD, immune_zscore) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = response_splitSD),
                 outlier.size = 0,
                 outlier.stroke = 0) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.2) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = 1,
        xend = 2,
        y = y,
        yend = y
      ),
      data = y_df,
      lineend = "square", 
      size = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_text(aes(
      x = 1.5,
      y = y + 0.25,
      label = sprintf("%.4f", p.value)
    ),
    data = w_out) +
    facet_grid( ~ treatment) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_response) +
    theme(
      axis.line.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
```


```{r, fig.width = 4, fig.height = 5}
plot_response_by_immune_score_per_treatment(bulk_clin_metadata) + 
  facet_wrap(~treatment, ncol = 2)
```

# Response within immune-stratified cohorts

```{r}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))

# library(factoextra)
library(UpSetR)

set.seed(42)
```


## Set up

```{r}
immune_hi.v.lo_df <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "immune_hi.v.lo.rds"))
bulk_clin_metadata <- read_tsv(file.path(data_dir, "bulk", "bulk-clin-metadata.tsv")) %>% 
  filter(is.na(excluded_clin) & is.na(excluded_rna)) %>% 
  drop_na(sample_RNA) %>% 
  select(-immune_hi.v.lo, -immune_zscore, -immune_hi.v.lo_zscore) %>% 
  left_join(immune_hi.v.lo_df, by = "sample_RNA") 
immune_signatures <- read_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "immune_signatures.tsv"))$signatures

gs_vec <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "gs_vec.rds"))
ssgsea_df <- read_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "ssgsea_df.tsv"))
ssgsea_tidy <- ssgsea_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = 2:ncol(.), 
               names_to = "sample_RNA", 
               values_to = "score") %>% 
  group_by(gs_name) %>% 
  mutate(zscore = as.vector(scale(score))) %>% 
  ungroup()

dge_immune_df <- read_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "dge_treatment_immune_df.tsv"))
gsea_immune_df <- read_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "gsea_R.v.NR_by_treatment_immune.tsv"))

dge_df <- read_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "dge_treatment.tsv"))
gsea_df <- read_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "gsea_treatment.tsv"))

wes_df <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "bulk", "discovery_wes_stats.csv"))
```

```{r}
  "hypoxia/OxPhos", 
  "TNFA/EMT",
  "T cell signaling/ APP/cancer" 
) %>% set_names(1:8)
cluster_df_labelled <- cluster_df %>%
  left_join(as_tibble(nsig_df, rownames = "gs_name"), by = "gs_name") %>%
  arrange(cluster) %>%
  mutate(cluster_label = cluster_labels[as.character(value)]) %>%
  mutate(cluster_label = factor(cluster_label, levels = cluster_labels)) %>%
  mutate(label_met = str_detect(gs_name, "METABOLISM|DEGRADATION|BIOSYNTHESIS")) %>% 
  mutate(label_gs = case_when(
    cluster_label == "metabolism 1" ~ str_detect(gs_name, "METABOLISM|DEGRADATION|BIOSYNTHESIS"), 
    cluster_label == "metabolism 2" ~ str_detect(gs_name, "METABOLISM|DEGRADATION|BIOSYNTHESIS"), 
    cluster_label == "TNFA/EMT" ~ str_detect(gs_name, "TNFA|EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL"), 
    cluster_label == "hypoxia/OxPhos" ~ str_detect(gs_name, "HYPOXIA|OXIDATIVE"), 
    cluster_label == "IFNG signaling" ~ str_detect(gs_name, "INTERFERON_GAMMA"), 
    cluster_label == "T cell signaling/ APP/cancer" ~ str_detect(gs_name, "TCELL"), 
    cluster_label == "cell cycle" ~ str_detect(gs_name, "G2M|E2F|CELL_CYCLE|DNA"), 
    cluster_label == "glycolysis/mTORC" ~ str_detect(gs_name, "GLYCOLYSIS|MTORC"), 
    TRUE ~ FALSE
  ))
```

## GSEA shift between immune high and low, by treatment

```{r}
delta_df <- gsea_immune_df %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(treatment, gs_name), 
              names_from = immune_hi.v.lo, 
              values_from = c(sscore, q.val)) %>% 
  mutate(delta_high_over_low = `sscore_immune high` - `sscore_immune low`) %>% 
  group_by(treatment) %>% 
  arrange(delta_high_over_low) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  mutate(direction = ifelse(delta_high_over_low > 0, "high>low", "low>high")) %>% 
  mutate(
    direction_flipped = ifelse(
      `sscore_immune high` * `sscore_immune low` > 0,
      "no change in direction",
      "change in direction"
    )
  )
```

### aPD1

```{r}
delta_df %>%
  filter(treatment == "aPD1") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(rank, delta_high_over_low) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(aes(
    xend = rank,
    y = `sscore_immune high`,
    yend = `sscore_immune low`,
  )) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = `sscore_immune high`, 
        label = gs_name),
    size = 5,
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1, 
    data = ~ ..1 %>% filter(gs_name %in% c(
      "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA",
      "HALLMARK_GLYCOLYSIS",
      "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION"
    )
  )) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = `sscore_immune low`, 
        label = gs_name),
    size = 5,
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1, 
    data = ~ ..1 %>% filter(gs_name %in% c("HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE")
  )) +
  geom_point(aes(y = `sscore_immune high`, 
                 shape = `q.val_immune high` < 0.05),
             size = 2, 
             color = "red") +
  geom_point(aes(y = `sscore_immune low`, 
                 shape = `q.val_immune low` < 0.05),
             size = 2, 
             color = "blue") + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(4, 19)) + 
  remove_x_spine() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "top") + 
  labs(y = "Change in normalized enrichment", 
       title = "aPD1")
```

Change in direction 

```{r}
delta_df %>% 
  group_by(treatment, direction_flipped) %>% 
  filter(treatment != "combo") %>% 
  count() %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = treatment, 
              names_from = direction_flipped, 
              values_from = n) %>% 
  mutate(pct_changed = `change in direction` / 254 * 100)
```

```{r, fig.width = 5.5, fig.height = 4}
hypoxia_gs <- c(
  "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA", 
  "HALLMARK_GLYCOLYSIS", 
  "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION",
  "HALLMARK_ANGIOGENESIS", 
  "HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING", 
  "KEGG_VEGF_SIGNALING_PATHWAY", 
  "HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION" 
  # "KEGG_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION"
)
gsea_immune_df %>% 
  filter(treatment == "aPD1") %>% 
  filter(immune_hi.v.lo == "immune high") %>% 
  mutate(direction = ifelse(sscore > 0, "R", "NR")) %>% 
  arrange(sscore) %>% 
  mutate(gs_name = factor(gs_name, levels = gs_name)) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(gs_name, sscore) + 
  geom_line(aes(group = 1)) +
  geom_area(aes(x = seq_along(gs_name), fill = direction), 
            alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = direction), data = ~..1 %>% filter(q.val < 0.1)) + 
  geom_point(
    aes(y = sscore + 0.2*(sscore / abs(sscore)), 
        alpha = q.val < 0.05, 
        color = direction), 
    data = ~ ..1 %>% filter(gs_name %in% hypoxia_gs),
    shape = 62,
    size = 5
  )+
  geom_text(
    aes(y = sscore + 0.35*(sscore / abs(sscore)), 
        alpha = q.val < 0.05, 
        color = direction, 
        label = gs_name %>% str_remove("HALLMARK_") %>% str_remove("KEGG_")), 
    data = ~..1 %>% filter(gs_name %in% hypoxia_gs), 
    hjust = 1, 
    size = 4
  ) + 
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = ~c(..1[1]*5, ..1[2]), 
                     breaks = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)) + 
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.4, 1)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = palette_response) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette_response) + 
  theme(legend.position = c(0.3, 0.6), 
        axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank()) 
```

## ssGSEA hypoxia

```{r, fig.width = 3, fig.height = 4}
plot_df <- ssgsea_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = 2:ncol(.)) %>% 
  filter(gs_name %in% c("HALLMARK_HYPOXIA")) %>% 
  left_join(bulk_clin_metadata, by = c("name" = "sample_RNA")) %>% 
  filter(treatment %in% c("aPD1", "aPD1 (prior aCTLA4)")) %>% 
  drop_na(response) %>% 
  mutate(response = factor(response, levels = c("NR", "R")))  %>%
  mutate(immune_hi.v.lo = factor(immune_hi.v.lo, levels = c("immune low", "immune high"))) 
plot_summary_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(immune_hi.v.lo, response, treatment) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(value),
            se = sd(value) / sqrt(n()))
ggplot(data = plot_df) + 
  aes(response, value) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean), data = plot_summary_df, size = 1) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = mean, group = immune_hi.v.lo), 
            data = plot_summary_df) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se, y = mean), 
                width = 0.25, 
                data = plot_summary_df) + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.2) + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("R", "NR")), 
                     method = "t.test") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = ~c(..1[1], ..1[2]*1.05), expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  facet_grid(treatment~immune_hi.v.lo) + 
  remove_x_spine() + 
  labs(y = "Hypoxia response score (ssGSEA)", x = "response (SD not incl.)")
```

## ssGSEA glycolysis, EMT, angio

```{r}

plot_ssgsea_boxplot_sig <- function(gs_str) {
  plot_df <- ssgsea_df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = 2:ncol(.)) %>%
    filter(gs_name %in% c(gs_str)) %>%
    left_join(bulk_clin_metadata, by = c("name" = "sample_RNA")) %>%
    mutate(immune_hi.v.lo = factor(immune_hi.v.lo, levels =c(
      "immune low", "immune high"
    ))) %>% 
    filter(treatment %in% c("aPD1")) %>%
    drop_na(response) %>%
    mutate(response = factor(response, levels = c("NR", "R")))
  
  ggplot(data = plot_df) +
    aes(response, value) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0,
                 outlier.stroke = 0,
                 aes(fill = response)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.5) +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("R", "NR")),
                       method = "t.test") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = ~ c(..1[1], ..1[2] * 1.1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    facet_grid(treatment ~ immune_hi.v.lo) +
    remove_x_spine() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_response) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    labs(x = "response (SD not incl.)")
}
```

```{r, fig.width = 3, fig.height = 2.75}
                width = 0.25, 
                data = plot_summary_df) + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.2) + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("R", "NR")), 
                     method = "t.test") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = ~c(..1[1], ..1[2]*1.1), expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  facet_grid(treatment~immune_hi.v.lo) + 
  remove_x_spine() + 
  labs(y = "EMT (ssGSEA)", x = "response (SD not incl.)", title = "aPD1")
```



## multivariate modeling


## Modeling hypoxia and immune score

```{r}
predict_df <- bulk_clin_metadata %>% 
  select(sample_RNA, immune_zscore, immune_hi.v.lo, response, treatment, cohort) %>% 
  drop_na(response) %>% 
  mutate(immune_hi.v.lo = factor(immune_hi.v.lo, levels = c("immune low", "immune high"), ordered = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(response = case_when(
    response == "R" ~ 1, 
    response == "NR" ~ 0
  )) %>% 
  mutate(treatment = factor(
    treatment,
    levels = c("aPD1", "aCTLA4", "combo"),
    ordered = FALSE
  )) 

glm_out <- glm(response ~ treatment * immune_zscore, data = predict_df, family = "binomial")
summary(glm_out)
```

```{r}
ssgsea_tidy %>% 
  filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA") %>% 
  left_join(predict_df, by = "sample_RNA") %>% 
  filter(treatment == "aPD1") %>% 
  mutate(immune_hi.v.lo = factor(immune_hi.v.lo, levels = c("immune high", "immune low"))) %>% 
  glm(response ~ zscore * immune_hi.v.lo, 
      data = ., 
      family = "binomial") %>% 
  summary()
```

```{r}
aic_df <- c(
  "response ~ zscore * immune_hi.v.lo",
  "response ~ zscore + immune_hi.v.lo",
  "response ~ zscore",
  "response ~ immune_hi.v.lo",
  "response ~ 1"
) %>% set_names() %>%
  map_dfr(~ {
    ssgsea_tidy %>%
      filter(gs_name == "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA") %>%
      left_join(predict_df, by = "sample_RNA") %>%
      filter(treatment == "aPD1") %>%
      mutate(immune_hi.v.lo = factor(immune_hi.v.lo, levels = c("immune high", "immune low"))) %>%
      glm(formula(paste(..1)),
          data = .,
          family = "binomial") %>%
      AIC()
  }, .id = "model")
aic_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = colnames(.), 
               values_to = "AIC") %>% 
  arrange(AIC)
```

In summary: when trying to model response WITHIN the group of patients treated with anti-PD-1 which were immune high, immune score does not matter but hypoxia score does. Within the group of patients treated with anti-PD-1 which were immune low, neither hypoxia or immune score matter. 


# Bulk RNA-seq quality control and batch correction

```{r}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))
```

## Legend

Bulk RNA-seq processing and batch correction. 

a) Diagram detailing bulk RNA-seq processing. 
b) PCA pre-batch correction showing a technical batch effect by sequencing modality.
c) PCA post-batch correction showing mixing of samples with different sequencing modalities. 
d) PCA pre-batch correction showing cohort annotations. 
e) PCA post-batch correction showing cohorts annotations. 


## Diagram of Bulk RNAseq Workflow

```{r}
knitr::include_graphics(here("images", "edfig2-rna-qc-diagram.png"))
```

## Set up

As always, read in the data first. 

```{r}
bulk_clin_metadata <- read_tsv(file.path(data_dir, "bulk", "bulk-clin-metadata.tsv")) 
tpm_df <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "tpm_df.rds"))
tpm_df_combatseq <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "tpm_df_combatseq.rds"))
```

Then, calculate the PCA. 

```{r}
pca_out <- tpm_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  t() %>%
  prcomp(scale = TRUE)

pca_combatseq_out <- tpm_df_combatseq %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sample_RNA") %>% 
  prcomp(scale = TRUE)
```

```{r}
plot_pca <- function(pca_out,
                     metadata,
                     metadata_join_str,
                     color_var) {
  color_var <- enquo(color_var)
  
  pca_df <- pca_out$x %>%
    as_tibble(rownames = metadata_join_str)
  percentVar <- pca_out$sdev ^ 2 / sum(pca_out$sdev ^ 2)
  
  pca_df %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = metadata_join_str) %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = !!color_var) +
    geom_point(size = 2, shape = 1) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PC1: ", round(percentVar[1] * 100), "% variance"),
      y = paste0("PC2: ", round(percentVar[2] * 100), "% variance")
    )
}
```

## PCA, pre, sequencing modality

```{r}
plot_pca(pca_out, bulk_clin_metadata, "sample_RNA", sequencing_modality) + 
  coord_fixed() 
```

## PCA, post, sequencing modality

```{r}
plot_pca(pca_combatseq_out, bulk_clin_metadata, "sample_RNA", sequencing_modality) + 
  coord_fixed() 
```

## PCA, pre, cohort

```{r}
plot_pca(pca_out, bulk_clin_metadata, "sample_RNA", cohort) + 
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette_cohort) 
```

## PCA, post, cohort
```{r}
plot_pca(pca_combatseq_out, bulk_clin_metadata, "sample_RNA", cohort) + 
  coord_fixed() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = palette_cohort)
```









# Additional clinical information of the bulk cohorts

```{r}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper.R"))

# document specific packages: 
library(ggalluvial)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```

## Legend

Title: Additional clinical features in the bulk cohort. 

a) Details of the relationship between response, progression, and treatment for all samples included in the bulk RNA-seq analysis shown in a Sankey diagram. 
b) Overall survival rates stratified by treatment group. 
All samples which passed clinical exclusion criteria were considered; 350 samples were missing survival data or had subsequent treatment. 
The survival rates between the four treatments was significantly different (Log-rank p<0.0001). 
Significance of pair-wise log-rank also shown. 
c) Response rates by treatment group and cohort.
Response rates between cohorts and within the same treatment group were not significantly different (Fisher's Exact P>0.05 for all groups).

```{r}
  filter(is.na(excluded_clin))
```

```{r, fig.asp = 0.333}
stratum_width <- 0.35
rna_clin_metadata %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = rev(names(palette_treatment)))) %>% 
  mutate(response_code = case_when(
    response == "R" ~ "R", 
    response == "NR" ~ "NR",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_ 
  )) %>% 
  mutate(progressed = case_when(
```

## Overall survival

```{r}
surv_clin_metadata <- bulk_clin_metadata %>%
  filter(is.na(excluded_clin)) %>%
  filter(cohort != "2016 Weber") %>%
  filter(cohort != "2022 Freeman") %>%
  filter(cohort != "2023 Campbell (067)") %>% 
  drop_na(censor_os_alive_1_dead_0) %>%
  mutate(censor_os = abs(censor_os_alive_1_dead_0 - 1)) %>%
  mutate(os_months = os_days / 30.4375) %>%
  mutate(
    os_months = ifelse(os_months > 60, 60, os_months),
    censor_os = ifelse(os_months > 60, 0, censor_os)
  )
```

```{r}
nrow(bulk_clin_metadata) - nrow(surv_clin_metadata)
```

```{r}
os_fit <- survfit(
  Surv(os_months, censor_os) ~ treatment,
  data = surv_clin_metadata
)
plot_surv_fit(
  os_fit,
  title_str = "Overall Survival",
  legend.labs = names(palette_treatment),
  palette = unname(palette_treatment)
)
```

Pairwise p-values: 

```{r}
for (treatment_str in unique(surv_clin_metadata$treatment)) {
  if (treatment_str != "aPD1") {
    out <- survdiff(
      Surv(os_months, censor_os) ~ treatment,
      data = surv_clin_metadata %>% 
        filter(treatment %in% c("aPD1", treatment_str))
    )
    print(paste0("aPD1 vs ", treatment_str))
    print(out$pvalue)
  }
}

for (treatment_str in unique(surv_clin_metadata$treatment)) {
  if (treatment_str != "combo") {
    out <- survdiff(
      Surv(os_months, censor_os) ~ treatment,
      data = surv_clin_metadata %>% 
        filter(treatment %in% c("combo", treatment_str))
    )
    print(paste0("combo vs ", treatment_str))
    print(out$pvalue)
  }
}

out <- survdiff(
  Surv(os_months, censor_os) ~ treatment,
  data = surv_clin_metadata %>% 
    filter(treatment %in% c("aCTLA4", "aPD1 (prior aCTLA4)"))
)
print("aCTLA4 vs aPD1 with prior")
print(out$pvalue)
```

## Response rates

```{r}
get_response_counts_df_by_var <- function(clin_metadata, var1, var2) {
  var1 <- enquo(var1)
  var2 <- enquo(var2)
  response_counts_df <- clin_metadata %>%  
    drop_na(response_splitSD) %>%
    named_group_split(!!var1) %>%
    map_dfr( ~ calculate_proportion(..1, !!var2, response_splitSD) , .id = rlang::as_name(var1)) %>%
    mutate(var_n = paste0(!!var2, "\nn=", total)) %>% 
    # mutate(treatment = paste0(!!var2, "\nn=", total)) %>%
    mutate(response_splitSD = factor(response_splitSD, levels = c("R", "NR"))) 
  return(response_counts_df)
  
}
plot_response_counts <- function(response_counts_df, var2) {
  var2 <- enquo(var2)
  response_counts_df %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(!!var2, prop, fill = response_splitSD) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_response) +
    theme(
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
      legend.direction = "vertical", 
      legend.position = c(1.2, 1),
      plot.margin = margin(r = 35, t = 7)
    ) +
    labs(x = rlang::as_name(var2), y = "Proportion", fill = "Response")
}
```

```{r}
counts_df <- bulk_clin_metadata %>% 
  filter(is.na(excluded_clin)) %>% 
  get_response_counts_df_by_var(treatment, cohort)
```

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.asp = 1/3}

  plot_response_counts(var_n) + 
  labs(x = "Cohort") + 
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line())
p + facet_wrap(~treatment, scale = "free_x", ncol = 8)  
```

```{r}
counts_df %>% 
  named_group_split(treatment) %>%
  map_dfr(
    ~ ..1 %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = cohort,
        names_from = response_splitSD,
        values_from = n
      ) %>%
      column_to_rownames("cohort") %>%
      fisher.test() %>%

    .id = "treatment")
```

## Legend

a) Barplot denoting the number of significant enriched gene sets in responders versus non-responders for each treatment group. 
b-d) Scatterplots denoting enrichment scores of signatures through pre-ranked gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA). 
Each plot compares two treatment groups: (b) anti-CTLA-4 versus combo, (c) anti-PD-1 versus combo, (d) anti-CTLA-4 versus anti-PD-1. 
Signatures which are significant in both comparisons are shown as a point; non-significant signatures are shown as an 'x'. 
Notable signatures labelled.

```{r}
plot_pca <- function(pca_out,
                     metadata,
                     metadata_join_str,
                     color_var) {
  color_var <- enquo(color_var)
  
  pca_df <- pca_out$x %>%
    as_tibble(rownames = metadata_join_str)
  percentVar <- pca_out$sdev ^ 2 / sum(pca_out$sdev ^ 2)
  
  pca_df %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = metadata_join_str) %>%
    drop_na(!!color_var) %>% 
    ggplot() +
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = !!color_var) +
    geom_point(size = 2, shape = 1) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PC1: ", round(percentVar[1] * 100), "% variance"),
      y = paste0("PC2: ", round(percentVar[2] * 100), "% variance")
    )
}
```


## Legend

Details of immune stratification and response rates by treatment and immune state. 

a) The distribution of immune score in the immune low and immune high groups. 
b) Odds ratio (OR) for response to combination ICB versus response to anti-PD1 ICB in immune high and immune low patients. 
c) Odds ratio (OR) for response to combination ICB versus response to anti-CTLA4 ICB in immune high and immune low patients. 
d) Model comparison analysis demonstrating that the best fit model is one that considers the interaction between immune score and treatment. 
e) Progression free survival for each treatment stratified by immune state. 
Only samples with bulk RNA-seq considered. 
P-values from log rank test.

## odds ratio of response, combo vs aPD1

```{r}
calculate_fisher_response_by_state <- function(clin_metadata) {
  prop_df <- clin_metadata %>%
    drop_na(response_splitSD) %>%
    group_by(immune_hi.v.lo, treatment, response_splitSD) %>%
    count() %>%
    group_by(immune_hi.v.lo, treatment) %>%
    mutate(total = sum(n), prop = n / total)
  fisher_df <- prop_df %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(immune_hi.v.lo, treatment),
      names_from = response_splitSD,
      values_from = n
    ) %>%
    named_group_split(immune_hi.v.lo) %>%
    map_dfr(
      ~ ..1 %>%
        select(-immune_hi.v.lo) %>%
        column_to_rownames("treatment") %>%
        fisher.test() %>%
        broom::tidy(),
      .id = "immune_hi.v.lo"
    )
}
```

```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 2}
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 2

fisher_out <- calculate_fisher_response_by_state(bulk_clin_metadata %>% filter(treatment %in% c("aPD1", "combo")))
fisher_out %>% 
  mutate(p.value.symbol = case_when(
    p.value < 0.001 ~ "***", 
    p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",  
    p.value < 0.05 ~ "*", 
    TRUE ~ "n.s."
  )) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(immune_hi.v.lo, estimate) + 
  geom_col(width = 0.5, size = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(estimate, digits = 3), y = 0.05),
            color = "white",
            hjust = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%s (p=%.2f)", p.value.symbol, p.value)),
            color = "black",
            hjust = -0.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1,
             color = "grey",
             linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = ~c(0, ..1[2]*1.5)) +
  labs(x = "Immune State", y = "Odds Ratio (R to combo / R to aPD1)") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank())
```

## Predictive models for response utilizing immune score

```{r}
predict_df <- bulk_clin_metadata %>% 
  select(sample_RNA, immune_zscore, immune_hi.v.lo, response_splitSD, treatment, cohort) %>% 
  drop_na(response_splitSD) %>% 
  mutate(immune_hi.v.lo = factor(immune_hi.v.lo, levels = c("immune low", "immune high"), ordered = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(response = case_when(
    response_splitSD == "R" ~ 1, 
    response_splitSD == "NR" ~ 0
  )) %>% 
  mutate(treatment = factor(
    treatment,
    levels = c("aPD1", "aCTLA4", "combo"),
    ordered = FALSE
  )) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sample_RNA")
```

```{r}
models <- list(
  "response ~ 1",
  "response ~ immune_zscore", 
  "response ~ treatment", 
  "response ~ treatment + immune_zscore", 
  "response ~ treatment * immune_zscore"
) %>% set_names()
```

```{r}
glm_out_list <- models %>% 
  map(~glm(formula(..1), data = predict_df, family = "binomial"))
glm_out_list %>% 
  map_dfr(~tibble(AIC = ..1$aic), .id = "variable") %>% 
  arrange(AIC) %>% 
  mutate(delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC))
```

## PFS by immune state

Survival rates for each treatment group with all cohorts combined. 

```{r}
surv_clin_metadata <- bulk_clin_metadata %>%
  filter(cohort != "2016 Weber") %>%
  filter(cohort != "2022 Freeman") %>%
  filter(cohort != "2023 Campbell (067)") %>%
  drop_na(censor_pfs_event_1_progressed_0) %>%
  mutate(censor_pfs = abs(censor_pfs_event_1_progressed_0 - 1)) %>%
  mutate(pfs_months = pfs_days / 30.4375) %>%
  mutate(
    pfs_months = ifelse(pfs_months > 60, 60, pfs_months),
    censor_pfs = ifelse(pfs_months > 60,  0, censor_pfs)
  )
```

```{r}
p_list <- list()
for (treatment_str in c("aPD1", "aCTLA4", "aPD1 (prior aCTLA4)", "combo")) {
```

```{r, fig.width = 4, fig.height = 4}
ggplot(data = plot_df) + 
  aes(response, value) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean), data = plot_summary_df, size = 1) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = mean, group = immune_hi.v.lo), 
            data = plot_summary_df) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se, y = mean), 
                width = 0.25, 
                data = plot_summary_df) + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.2) + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("R", "NR")), 
                     method = "t.test") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = ~c(..1[1], ..1[2]*1.05), expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  facet_grid(treatment~immune_hi.v.lo) + 
  remove_x_spine() + 
  labs(y = "Hypoxia response score (ssGSEA)", x = "response (SD not incl.)")
```

```{r, fig.height = 3, fig.width = 3}
ssgsea_df %>%
```

# Additional hypoxia signatures

```{r}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper.R"))
```

Is this result specific to the hypoxia signature used here (the Hallmark hypoxia signature)?

The answer is: no. To demonstrate this, we utilize the following signatures (downloaded from MSIGDB, with descriptions from (the website)[https://www.gsea-msigdb.org/gsea/msigdb]): 

* `BUFFA_HYPOXIA_METAGENE`: "Common genes regulated by hypoxia across multiple head and neck and breast cancer clinical cohorts, and prognostic in multiple cancer types"
* `HARRIS_HYPOXIA`: "Genes known to be induced by hypoxia"
* `WINTER_HYPOXIA_METAGENE`: "Genes regulated by hypoxia, based on literature searches."

## Read in data

```{r}
immune_hi.v.lo_df <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "immune_hi.v.lo.rds"))
bulk_clin_metadata <- read_tsv(file.path(data_dir, "bulk", "bulk-clin-metadata.tsv")) %>% 
  drop_na(sample_RNA) %>% 
  filter(is.na(excluded_clin) & is.na(excluded_rna)) %>% 
  select(-immune_hi.v.lo, -immune_zscore, -immune_hi.v.lo_zscore) %>% 
  left_join(immune_hi.v.lo_df, by = "sample_RNA")
ssgsea_tidy <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "ssgsea_tidy.rds"))
ssgsea_hypoxia_tidy <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "ssgsea_hypoxia_tidy.rds"))
```

## Hypoxia signatures

```{r}
plot_ssgsea <- function(ssgsea_tidy, gs_str) {
  plot_df <- ssgsea_tidy %>% 
    filter(NAME == gs_str) %>%
    drop_na(response) 
  plot_summary_df <- plot_df %>% 
    group_by(immune_hi.v.lo, response_splitSD, treatment) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(score),
              se = sd(score) / sqrt(n()))
  plot_df %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(response_splitSD, score) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean, group = immune_hi.v.lo), 
              data = plot_summary_df) + 
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se, y = mean), 
                  width = 0.25, 
                  data = plot_summary_df) + 
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5
    )) +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("NR", "R")), 
                       method = "t.test") +
    remove_x_spine() +
    labs(title = gs_str)+
    facet_wrap(~ treatment + immune_hi.v.lo, ncol = 2, scale = "free") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.2, 0)) + 
    labs(x = "Response")
}
```


```{r}
plot_ssgsea2 <- function(ssgsea_tidy, gs_str) {
  plot_df <- ssgsea_tidy %>% 
    filter(NAME == gs_str) %>%
    drop_na(response) 
  plot_summary_df <- plot_df %>% 
    group_by(immune_hi.v.lo, response_splitSD, treatment) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(score),
              se = sd(score) / sqrt(n()))
  plot_df %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(response_splitSD, score) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0, outlier.stroke = 0, 
                 aes(fill = response)) + 
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5
    )) +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("NR", "R")), 
                       method = "wilcox.test") +
    remove_x_spine() +
    labs(title = gs_str)+
    facet_wrap(~ treatment + immune_hi.v.lo, ncol = 2, scale = "free") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.2, 0)) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_response) + 
    labs(x = "Response", 
         y = "ssGSEA score") + 
    theme(legend.position = "none", 
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0))
}
```

# B16 murine tumor expression

```{r}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper.R"))

theme_set(figure_theme())

# document specific packages: 
library(Matrix)
```

## Set up

Murine expression data from two public sources: bulk FPKM from the B16 melanoma line
(GSE96972) and single cell TPM from the murine tumor atlas (E-MTAB-7427 / E-EHCA-2). 

```{r}
gse96972_dir <- here("data", "murine", "GSE96972")
ehca2_dir <- here("data", "murine", "E-MTAB-7427")
ehca2_quant_dir <- file.path(ehca2_dir, "E-EHCA-2-quantification-filtered-files")
```

## B16 hypoxia gene expression

```{r}
expr_df <- read_tsv(file.path(gse96972_dir, "hif_FPKM.txt"))
expr_tidy <- expr_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("siNTSFM", "siNTTCM"), 
               names_to = "media", 
               values_to = "FPKM")
```

```{r}
expr_tidy %>% 
  filter(Gene %in% c("Sdha", "Hif1a", "Epas1", "Vegfa")) %>% 
  mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = c(
    "Sdha", 
    "Hif1a", "Epas1", 
    "Vegfa"
  ))) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(Gene, FPKM, fill = media) + 
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + 
  remove_x_spine() + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5), 
        legend.position = "none") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey20", "grey60")) + 
  labs(title = "B16")
```

## Hypoxia gene expression by cell type in murine tumors

Cluster labels are assigned from the published clustering at K = 18. 

```{r}
cluster_key <- c(
  "1" = "T cell", 
  "2" = "DC", # cDC 
  "3" = "Endothelial cells", 
  "4" = "B cell", 
  "6" = "Fibroblasts", # CAF 1?
  "7" = "T cell", # gdT/MAIT
  "9" = "TAM", 
  "10" = "DC", # migDC
  "12" = "NK", 
  "11" = "DC", # cDC
  "14" = "Fibroblasts", # CAF 2?
  "16" = "Fibroblasts", # CAF 3?
  "17" = "DC" # pDC
)

raw_cluster_df <- read_tsv(file.path(ehca2_dir, "E-EHCA-2.clusters.tsv")) 
cluster_df <- raw_cluster_df %>% 
  select(-sel.K) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("K") %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "cell") %>% 
  mutate(cluster = cluster_key[as.numeric(`18`)])
```

```{r}
mtx <- readMM(file.path(ehca2_quant_dir, "E-EHCA-2.expression_tpm.mtx"))
col <- read_tsv(file.path(ehca2_quant_dir, "E-EHCA-2.expression_tpm.mtx_cols"), 
                col_names = FALSE)
row <- read_tsv(file.path(ehca2_quant_dir, "E-EHCA-2.expression_tpm.mtx_rows"), 
                col_names = FALSE)
rownames(mtx) <- row$X1
colnames(mtx) <- col$X1
```

```{r}
genes_of_interest <- c(
  "ENSMUSG00000021109" = "Hif1a", 
  "ENSMUSG00000024140" = "Epas1", 
  "ENSMUSG00000023951" = "Vegfa", 
  "ENSMUSG00000029648" = "Flt1", 
  "ENSMUSG00000062960" = "Kdr"
)
tpm_df <- t(mtx[rownames(mtx) %in% names(genes_of_interest), ]) %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "cell")

tpm_tidy <- tpm_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = names(genes_of_interest), 
               names_to = "ensembl_gene", 
               values_to = "TPM") %>% 
  mutate(gene = genes_of_interest[ensembl_gene]) %>% 
  left_join(cluster_df, by = "cell")
```

```{r}
tpm_tidy %>% 
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = c(
    "Hif1a", 
    "Epas1", 
    "Vegfa", 
    "Flt1", 
    "Kdr"
  ))) %>% 
  drop_na(cluster) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(cluster, log10(TPM + 1), fill = cluster) + 
  geom_violin(scale = "width", color = NA) + 
  facet_grid(~gene) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "none") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(palette_general_cell_type, 
                               palette_specific_immune)) + 
  labs(y = "Gene expression")
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1/3, fig.width = 9}
dotplot_df <-
```

Run a wilcox to test which groups have a significantly higher level of hypoxia relative to all other cells. 

```{r}
plot_df <- obs_df %>% 
  filter(general_cell_type != "Contaminating") 
cell_types <- unique(plot_df$general_cell_type) 
map_dfr(set_names(cell_types), ~{
  plot_df %>% 
    mutate(in_group = general_cell_type == ..1) %>% 
    summarise(wout = broom::tidy(wilcox.test(HALLMARK_HYPOXIA ~ in_group, alternative = "less"))) %>% 
    unnest(wout) 
}, .id = "general_cell_type")
```

The stromal and tumor groups do, the immune groups do not.

```{r, fig.asp = 1/2, fig.width = 6}
  remove_spines() + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  theme(legend.position = "top") +  
  labs(x = "interacting pair", y = "Significant in N samples")
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 3}
  filter(compartment == "Immune") %>% 
  left_join(mean_hypoxia_df, by = "sample_ID") %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(hypoxia_hi.v.lo, prop.x) + 
  geom_col(data = ~..1 %>% 
             group_by(hypoxia_hi.v.lo) %>% 
             summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop.x)), 
           aes(y = mean_prop)) + 
  geom_segment(data = ~..1 %>% 
                 group_by(hypoxia_hi.v.lo) %>% 
                 summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop.x), 
                           se_prop = sd(prop.x) / sqrt(n())), 
               aes(y = mean_prop - se_prop, yend = mean_prop + se_prop, 
                   xend = hypoxia_hi.v.lo)) + 
  geom_jitter(size = 2, width = 0.2) + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("low hypoxia", "high hypoxia")), 
                     test = "wilcox.test") + 
  remove_x_spine() + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("low", "mid", "high")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  labs(x = "hypoxia state", y = "immune frequency")
```

### Pb ols

```{r}
plot_pb_ols_ranks <- function(my_pb_ols) {
  my_pb_ols %>% 
    arrange(estimate) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(rank, estimate) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_line() +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = rank,
        xend = rank,
        y = 0,
        yend = estimate,
        color = category
      ),
      data = ~ ..1 %>% drop_na(category)
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = category, shape = p.value < 0.05),
               data = ~ ..1 %>% drop_na(category),
               size = 3) +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = gene, color = category),
      data = ~ ..1 %>% drop_na(category),
      force = 5,
      hjust = 1
    )  + 
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 19, "FALSE" = 4)) + 
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
}
```


```{r}
exhaustion_genes <- c("ENTPD1", "CXCL13", "CD101", "HAVCR2", 
                      "LAG3", "PDCD1")#, "CTLA4", "TIGIT")
activation_genes <- c("NFAT5", "TNFSF9")#, "KLRG1", "STAT1", "TAP1")
homing_genes <- c("CCR7")
hypoxia_genes <- c("HIF1A", "EPAS1")

pb_ols %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(cell_type == "CD8+ T") %>% 
  filter(term == "mean_hypoxia") %>% 
  arrange(desc(estimate)) %>% 
  mutate(category = case_when(
    gene %in% exhaustion_genes ~ "exhaustion", 
    gene %in% activation_genes ~ "activation", 
    # gene %in% homing_genes ~ "homing", 
    gene %in% hypoxia_genes ~ "hypoxia response" ,
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>% 
  plot_pb_ols_ranks() + 
  labs(title = "CD8+ T cells")
```

Run a wilcox to test which groups have a significantly higher level of hypoxia relative to all other cells. 

```{r}
plot_df <- obs_df %>% 
  filter(general_cell_type != "Contaminating") 
cell_types <- unique(plot_df$general_cell_type) 
map_dfr(set_names(cell_types), ~{
  plot_df %>% 
    mutate(in_group = general_cell_type == ..1) %>% 
    summarise(wout = broom::tidy(wilcox.test(HALLMARK_HYPOXIA ~ in_group, alternative = "less"))) %>% 
    unnest(wout) 
}, .id = "general_cell_type")
```

The stromal and tumor groups do, the immune groups do not.

```{r, fig.asp = 1/3, fig.width = 8}
                                        "FLT1", "KDR")), 
             scale = "free_x") + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = ~c(-0.01, ..1[2]*1.1), 
                     breaks = seq(0, 4, 1)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette_general_cell_type) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Gene expression")
```

## ECs are more angiogenic, less adhesive 

```{r}
hypoxia_genes <- c("HIF1A", "EPAS1", "VEGFA")
angiogenesis_genes <- c("SERPINE1", "MMP1", "ANGPT2", "PDGFA", "THBS1", "ESM1", "VWF")
cytokines_and_chemokines <- c("IL33", "CXCL6", "CXCL10")
adhesion <- c("EPCAM", "VCAM1")

pb_ols %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(cell_type == "Endothelial cells") %>% 
  filter(term == "mean_hypoxia") %>% 
  arrange(desc(estimate)) %>% 
  mutate(category = case_when(
    gene %in% hypoxia_genes ~ "hypoxia response" ,
    gene %in% angiogenesis_genes ~ "angiogenesis" ,
    gene %in% cytokines_and_chemokines ~ "cytokines and chemokines", 
    gene %in% adhesion ~ "adhesion", 
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>% 
  plot_pb_ols_ranks() + 
  labs(title = "Endothelial cells")
```

## CPDB: Number of interactions

```{r}

  group_by(id) %>%
```

Number of Fibroblast+Endothelial Interactions

```{r}
n_fibroblast_ints <- cpdb_tidy_stromal.imm_sig_df %>% 
  filter(name %>% str_detect("Fibroblasts")) %>% 
  mutate(int_with = str_remove(name, "Fibroblasts")) %>% 
  mutate(int_with = str_remove(int_with, "\\|")) %>% 
  group_by(id, int_with) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) 
n_endothelial_ints <- cpdb_tidy_stromal.imm_sig_df %>% 
  filter(name %>% str_detect("Endothelial")) %>% 
  mutate(int_with = str_remove(name, "Endothelial cells")) %>% 
  mutate(int_with = str_remove(int_with, "\\|")) %>%

  summarise(count = n())
```

#### Associated gene expr

```{r}

plot_pb_gene_from_cell_type <- function(cell_type_str, gene_str) {
  
  p1 <- pb_tidy %>%
    filter(cell_type == cell_type_str) %>%
    filter(gene == gene_str) %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(hypoxia_hi.v.lo, log1p_CPM) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0, outlier.stroke = 0) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.25, size = 2,
                aes(color = immune_prop)) +
    labs(title = paste0(cell_type_str, ", ", gene_str)) +
    rotate_x_text() +
    scale_color_viridis()
  p2 <- pb_tidy %>%
    filter(cell_type == cell_type_str) %>%
    filter(gene == gene_str) %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(mean_hypoxia, log1p_CPM) +
    geom_point(size = 2, aes(color = immune_prop)) + 
    labs(title = paste0(cell_type_str, ", ", gene_str)) +
    scale_color_viridis()
  
  plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol = 2, align = "h", axis = "tb")
}
```

## Exhaustion in CD8+ T cells 

```{r}
term_exh_genes <- c("HAVCR2", "LAG3", "PDCD1", "CTLA4", "CXCL13", "CD38", "CD101", "TIGIT", "ENTPD1", "SLAMF6", "PRDM1")
```

### Deseq wilcox

```{r}
deseq_wilcox %>%
  mutate(signed_neglog10_p = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, 
                                    -log10(pvalue), 
                                    log10(pvalue))) %>% 
  filter(cluster == "CD8+ T") %>%
  arrange(signed_neglog10_p) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(rank, signed_neglog10_p) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(
    data = ~ ..1 %>% filter(gene %in% term_exh_genes),
    size = 3,
    aes(color = p.value < 0.05)
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = gene),
                  data = ~ ..1 %>% filter(gene %in% term_exh_genes))
```

### Pb ols

```{r}
plot_df <- pb_ols %>% 
  filter(cell_type == "CD8+ T") %>% 
  filter(term == "mean_hypoxia") %>% 
  arrange(estimate) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) 
```

```{r, fig.width = 5}
plot_df %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(rank, estimate) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point(
    aes(color = p.value < 0.05), 
    data = ~ ..1 %>%
      filter(gene %in% term_exh_genes),
    size = 3
  )+
  geom_segment(aes(xend = rank, yend = 0, color = p.value < 0.05),
               data = ~ ..1 %>%
                 filter(gene %in% term_exh_genes)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = gene),
            hjust = 1.1, 
            angle = -45, 
            data = ~ ..1 %>%
              filter(gene %in% term_exh_genes)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = ~c(..1[1], ..1[2]*1.2))
```

```{r, fig.width = 5}
            hjust = 1.1, 
            # angle = -45, 
            data = ~ ..1 %>%
              filter(gene %in% mac_genes)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = ~c(..1[1], ..1[2]*1.2))
```

## Hypoxia associates with immunosuppressive DCs

```{r}
dc_genes <- c("IL10RA", "TNFAIP3", "S100A4", 
              "IRF8", "CD52", "IRF8", "CD74", "XCR1", 
              "CXCL8")
```

### Deseq wilcox

```{r}
deseq_wilcox %>%
  mutate(signed_neglog10_p = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, 
                                    -log10(pvalue), 
                                    log10(pvalue))) %>% 
  filter(cluster == "DC") %>%
  arrange(signed_neglog10_p) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(rank, signed_neglog10_p) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(
    data = ~ ..1 %>% filter(gene %in% dc_genes),
    size = 3,
    aes(color = pvalue < 0.05)
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = gene),
                  data = ~ ..1 %>% filter(gene %in% dc_genes))
```

### Pb ols

```{r}
plot_df <- pb_ols %>% 
  filter(cell_type == "DC") %>% 
  filter(term == "mean_hypoxia") %>% 
  arrange(estimate) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) 
```

```{r, fig.width = 5}
plot_df %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(rank, estimate) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point(
    aes(color = p.value < 0.05), 
    data = ~ ..1 %>%
      filter(gene %in% dc_genes),
    size = 3
  )+
  geom_segment(aes(xend = rank, yend = 0, color = p.value < 0.05),
               data = ~ ..1 %>%
                 filter(gene %in% dc_genes)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = gene),
            hjust = 1.1, 
            # angle = -45, 
            data = ~ ..1 %>%
              filter(gene %in% dc_genes)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = ~c(..1[1], ..1[2]*1.2))
```

```{r, fig.width = 8}
  left_join(mean_hypoxia_df, by = "sample_ID") %>%

  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0, outlier.stroke = 0) +

  facet_wrap(~general_cell_type, ncol = 4, scale = "free_y") +
```

## heatmap cor, general cell type

```{r}
mean_hypoxia_general_cell_type <- obs_df %>%
  filter(general_cell_type != "Contaminating") %>% 
  group_by(general_cell_type, sample_ID) %>%
  summarise(mean_hypoxia = mean(HALLMARK_HYPOXIA),
            n = n()) 
mean_hypoxia_wide <- mean_hypoxia_general_cell_type %>%
  filter(general_cell_type %in% c("Endothelial cells", "Fibroblasts", "Tumor", "Myeloid", "T cell")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = sample_ID,
              names_from = general_cell_type,
              values_from = mean_hypoxia, 
              values_fill = 0)
cor_mtx <- mean_hypoxia_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_ID") %>%
  cor(method = "pearson") 
```

```{r, fig.width = 3, fig.height = 3}
h_cor <- cor_mtx %>%
  Heatmap(
    col = colorRamp2(breaks = c(0, 1), colors = palette_cor[2:3]),
    name = "Pearson cor.",
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    row_dend_width = unit(2, "mm"),
    row_dend_gp = gpar(lwd = 0.2), 
    column_dend_height = unit(2, "mm"), 
    column_dend_gp = gpar(lwd = 0.2), 
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
      legend_width = unit(10, "mm"),
      grid_height = unit(1, "mm"), 
      title_position = "leftcenter", 
      legend_direction = "horizontal"
    ), 
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, col) {
      grid.text(format(cor_mtx[i, j], digits = 2), x, y, 
                gp = gpar(fontsize = 5))
    }
  )
draw(h_cor, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
```
